user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Homepage Accessibility - Initial Entry Point
proposed_scenarios.description: Basic test to confirm that users can successfully access the homepage of the website and initiate browsing. This is the foundational e2e workflow identified in the captured exploration data.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify users can reach the store's homepage as a prerequisite for all browsing and purchasing activities.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a prospective shopper, I want to navigate to the homepage so that I can start browsing products and make purchases.

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage and verify page is reachable at the root URL.
detailed_steps.business_impact: First impression and site accessibility; all other workflows depend on this entry point.

expected_results: User successfully loads the homepage without errors
Site responds within acceptable time limits
Homepage is the correct expected URL
edge_cases_to_test: What happens with slow or unstable internet connection
How does the homepage load if user navigates away and returns
How does the system handle homepage loads from multiple tabs or browser types
data_requirements: N/A (Homepage access requires no test data)
Stable internet connection for baseline testing
prerequisites: Website (https://atid.store/) is accessible and functional from the test environment
No maintenance or downtime during the test
All dependent services (e.g., DNS, CDN) are operational
